description: Returns number of historical aircraft flight positions. IMPORTANT: Timestamp is required, and at least one additional search parameter (other than limit) must be provided and non-empty.

airports.description: Airports (IATA/ICAO/ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) or countries. Use format: [direction:]<code>. Directions: inbound, outbound, both.

airspaces.description: Flight information region in lower or upper airspace.

bounds.description: Coordinates defining an area. Order: north, south, west, east (comma-separated float values).

categories.description: Categories of Flights (comma-separated: P, C, M, J, T, H, B, G, D, V, O, N).

data_sources.description: Source of information (comma-separated: ADSB, MLAT, ESTIMATED).

gspeed.description: Flight ground speed in knots (single value or range, e.g., 120-140, 80).

limit.description: Limit of results. Recommended, unless needed. Max 30000.

operating_as.description: Aircraft operating under an airline's call sign (ICAO code, comma-separated, max 15).

painted_as.description: Aircraft painted in an airline's livery (ICAO code, comma-separated, max 15).

routes.description: Flights between airports/countries (e.g., SE-US, ESSA-JFK). Max 15.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp for the historical snapshot.

name: get_historic_flights_count
